title: Bitclub Network   Russ Medlin Interview In Reykjavik Iceland 🔥 14 11 2018
description: Ready to mine Bitcoin and other crypto currencies, but you're not sure where to start? BitClub Network makes it easy.

asr.full_text: Ok, so we are here in Reykjavik, in my friend's farm of mining and he told us a few things about our BitClub networking. Russ, we are very excited to be here to see the Mining Farm and Bitcoin Mining. And can you tell us about the BC Club, just the benefits, two, three benefits about the BC Club the new product? Oh the BC club, I personally have saved in the first four months about $50,000 using all the different services. All the guys by 20 Mega Monsters have this already. Everybody saved money. We pay like I said $5,000 a year. BC Club's only $3,500 and $1,000 a year. I think when people start seeing the benefits, we're going to end up having tens of thousands of people sign up for it. Especially if you're flying business class, first class, they save so much money on airline tickets which I thought was impossible. But they always do it. Like I said, 30-40% every time. Hotel rooms, like if you're staying in a nice hotel suite, save 20, 30, 40 percent. And you'll have an app with 24 hour chat support. So, if you want to send somebody flowers, you just let them know you want to send flowers. You want to set up a tour somewhere, like you want to rent a Ferrari, you want to do like, they'll do, like they're a concierge service. It's like a personal assistant that will get anything for you any time. And then the discounts that they get, I don't know how they get such amazing discounts, but I've saved a ton and everybody else has too. So, it's a very personalized service and I'm really excited about that. What's really cool about it is that now people can basically sign up as a founder even without getting the mining. So that actually takes us to the point where even though mining is our core business, now we're not actually a hundred percent dependent on mining anymore. So if worst case scenario, Bitcoin went down to three thousand, we had to turn off the mining because it wasn't profitable anymore, we could still be signing up new people. in 2018 or later? It was supposed to be November 1st, there was a little bit of problems with the API's, with our systems and their systems, that they're fixing, but it's very very very close to the program. Programming's all done, as far as like compensation plan, websites are all done, I mean it's basically ready to go. We marketplace and the coinpay, is this a different product? Completely different. Completely separate. Nothing to do with each other at all. You can send out a company and the mergers to the marketplace? Well, right now the marketplace ties in with coinpay directly. So if merchants sign up on coinpay, they're going to be able to list their businesses and their products and services on the marketplace. Like that's part of the package for signing up with Coinpay. And then the marketplace will help everybody find the people that are accepting Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Clubcoin. So it just all ties together. And our entire invoicing system works on Coinpay right now. It's super, super, super smooth. We can let another business use it, but unless they have a team like programmers, they're gonna be really confused with all the instructions because it's more of programmers on that. So right now, we have teams working on tons of videos to host any bitcoin or blockchain conferences at all and so they were lumping us into that even though we're like no we're a company doing a company event we're not selling anything we're not promoting anything we're just doing recognition as a company event and they were like you can't so they kept feeling like maybe maybe they may maybe now like like a week and a half ago they Greece reminds me of a lot of different countries that it's really hard to promote businesses. I just had a guy here from Venezuela that, his first 3 months, he's done over $700,000 in sales... personally, not just down the line, but personally in Venezuela. And the monthly income there the average is $2 a month. So, we are going to get fun today and then blue lagoon afterwards So it's time to get to the car now to the mining farm the shots are about to come out We took it down, caged it in, we're forsaken lies I guess we've been right, just long enough Nothing but chewing on those strings of love While the moon slips out the door Keep asking back for more It's what we came here for If she won't see us anymore Then what will we sing? What is it we'll shout out for? Or leave this trace We're on the run We won't see us anymore Now what will we sing? What is it we'll shout out for? We'll pour it just a little more

textual.potential_relevance: A substantial savings claim is linked to joining or paying for a membership with stated annual fees, making the relationship between payment and promised financial benefit relevant for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the savings figures are accurate, typical, guaranteed, independently verified, or dependent on additional conditions.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes paid BitClub membership and mining participation using unusually broad savings claims while presenting continued signups as viable even if mining becomes unprofitable. The speakers describe annual payments and encourage expansion to tens of thousands of members, making the central message an active solicitation rather than neutral reporting or operational education.
